messages:
Mia Chen: Noticed a small UI clash — compact modal launched from the header sits almost flush under the breadcrumb on 1280px, looks tight.
Sam Patel: I can repro. Which modal variant?
Mia Chen: quick-filter, compact. Screenshot uploaded to staging.
Zara Khan: We tightened vertical padding in the density sweep, but header/breadcrumb still use the legacy shell gap token. Likely a token scale mismatch.
Arjun Iyer: Current CSS snippet: ```css
.modal--compact { padding-top: var(--spacing-compact-1); }
.header { padding-bottom: var(--shell-gap); }
```
Arjun Iyer: Suggest adding `--spacing-compact-2` mid token and using it for modal top and header bottom so gap is consistent.
Mia Chen: Also seeing toasts stack under the sticky mini-player on some pages — they are viewport-anchored and ignore `--shell-bottom`.
Oliver Park: I'll take toast fix — either move container into `.app-shell` or add `bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + var(--shell-bottom))`. Prefer moving it into shell for predictable stacking with player.
design-bot: lint: token "--spacing-compact-2" not found. Recommend adding to tokens scale (lint-id: spacing-7721).
Sam Patel: Plan: 1) add `--spacing-compact-2` (12px) to tokens; 2) update modal top and header bottom to use it; 3) move toast container into `.app-shell` and include `--shell-bottom` in calc. Will include ARIA check.
Mia Chen: Accessibility note: NVDA reads header then dialog when modal is adjacent — ensure focus trap and `aria-modal=\"true\"`, and `aria-labelledby` points only to modal title (not header IDs). Add to PR checklist.
Oliver Park: Toast PR incoming. Moving markup and updating CSS, running visual diffs.
Sam Patel: PR opened for token + modal + a11y fix, staging link in PR.
Mia Chen: Reviewed both PRs, spot-checked staging at multiple widths. Spacing now consistent, toasts no longer hidden. Screen reader test passes. Merging changes.
Mia Chen: Closing thread — thanks!
